measure_name: Project-financed climate and disaster risk assessment
definition: Evaluates natural hazards, exposure, vulnerability or service disruption to inform investment, design or operations for existing or proposed infrastructure. Includes screening, hazard mapping and technical hazard studies. Excludes Bank appraisal screening, unrelated assessments, and using existing hazard or risk data to target beneficiaries or support without producing an assessment. Includes laws, regulations, standards and plans specifically about climate risk assessment, including standing assessment rules. Ongoing monitoring services are climate_information_systems. Assessment findings alone do not establish implementation of recommended measures.
boundary: Not ongoing monitoring services, which are climate_information_systems; not Bank appraisal screening; and not using existing hazard or risk data to target beneficiaries, unless an application does so (climate_information_systems).
